Metadata.description: A cozy single-player game of paper cut-outs: do your daily quests, open booster packs and complete your master set binders.

lines.rewarded: Spotless! You saved my life. Here are your 100 coins.

lines.greeting: Heh heh, fancy a game of memory, {name}? Find the 8 pairs in 20 moves at most… and I’ll give you 150 coins. But I warn you, I never lose!
lines.rewarded: Well I never, you beat me! What a memory. Here are your 150 coins, well earned.
lines.failed: Ha ha! Out of moves! Don’t worry, I’ve had a hundred years to practise. Another round?
lines.alreadyDone: One defeat at memory a day is quite enough for my pride! But if you fancy skipping a few stones, I’m your man.
lines.unavailable: Hmm, I’ve mislaid my cards… Try again in a moment.

1.text: Patience is a tree with bitter roots, but very sweet fruit.

2.text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.

3.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

4.text: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.

6.text: Dripping water hollows out the stone.

7.text: Ask, and you look a fool for five minutes. Don’t, and you stay one forever.

8.text: When you drink water, remember the spring.

9.text: The bamboo that bends is stronger than the oak that resists.

10.text: The frog at the bottom of the well knows nothing of the ocean.

11.text: One day with a good teacher is worth a thousand days of study.

13.text: If you are in a hurry, take the long way round.

14.text: You can’t see the forest with your nose against a tree.

15.text: The slow tortoise goes further than the sleeping hare.

16.text: A smile costs less than electricity, but gives as much light.

17.text: Even a long journey is made one cup of tea at a time.

18.text: The nail that sticks out gets hammered down.

19.text: Learning is like rowing upstream: stop, and you drift back.

20.text: Kind words cost nothing and are worth a lot.

21.text: A house without books is like a body without a soul.

23.text: A friend knows the song of your heart.

24.text: Be not afraid of going slowly, only of standing still.

25.text: Even the tallest tower starts from the ground.

26.text: The wind doesn’t always blow the way the boat wants.

27.text: When the wise man points at the moon, the fool looks at the finger.

28.text: Better to light a candle than to curse the darkness.

29.text: Memory is a garden: it needs watering every day.

30.text: Flipped cards never lie, but they love to hide.

News.title: What’s new?
News.intro: What changed in the village since you last came by.

items.versionBadge: The game’s version number now shows small in the bottom-left corner. Handy when you tell us about a problem!
items.passwordEye: An eye shows your password as you type it, and signing up asks you to confirm it.
items.binderNeeded: A booster won before you own its binder now waits in your bag until you buy the binder from Granny Hazel.
items.singleBoosterCut: On phones, cutting a pack could open several boosters at once, or show an error instead of the cards. One swipe now opens a single booster.
items.dialogFocus: After a game, the button of the character’s answer is ready to press, whatever your browser.
items.dalgonaFreeze: Gaspard’s biscuit no longer freezes when the time of day or the weather changes mid-game.
items.dalgonaGiveUp: In the dalgona, Space on “Give up” now gives up instead of carving.
items.setLogos: A few sets showed their name instead of their logo. Their logos are back.
items.everySetOnSale: Every set is on sale! Granny Hazel has every binder, and the Den’s triplets share the boosters: the 30th anniversary and the Mega Evolutions at Filou’s, the sets of old at Frimousse’s, the newer ones at Fripouille’s.
items.newsSheet: This very sheet! It tells you what changed in the game whenever you come by, and you can read it again from the settings.
items.ramenShop: Ramen Yuzu opens downtown, between the towers! Yuzu the red panda hires you for three little jobs paid in coins: washing up, the kitchen and waiting tables.
items.anySixQuests: The daily bonus now takes any 6 quests of your choice: no need to do them all.
items.dojo: The dojo opens downtown, next to Ramen Yuzu! Master Kaito, an old badger, trains you in vegetable slicing and archery: two new daily quests paid in coins. At the dojo as at Yuzu’s, replay as often as you like: each new star of the day pays you the difference in coins, up to 300 coins for three stars.
items.parkQuests: At Linden Park, Pépin the squirrel gardener has you clean up the lawn and water his flowers, and Papy Caillou teaches you to skip stones: three new daily quests. The clean-up and the stones can be replayed for every star, and the gentle watering is done once a day.
items.villageQuests: News in the village! Mamie Noisette asks her daily quiz, Bérénice runs Pop’Balloons at her stand, and Gustave the heron opens the village post, between the shop and the bookshop: three new daily quests.
items.painterKittenPhotos: Three new daily quests! Pinceau the sheep paints by the park’s lake and needs help with his sliding puzzle, Mme Ronron is looking for her kitten hidden somewhere, and Flash the chameleon photographs the big city’s sky.
items.keyboardShortcuts: On a computer, the keys now show at the bottom of the screen. New shortcuts: B opens your boosters, C your binder, and Esc the settings. While opening a booster, Esc skips straight to your new cards.
items.mobileActionPrompt: On phones, the button to interact now shows above the joystick and the Dash button, rather than squeezed between them.
items.freezeLastMove: At the end of a quest game, the screen now stays on your last move so you can see how it went. Press “See the score” when you’re ready.
items.lowStones: Papy Caillou’s skipping stones are more like the real thing: throw low and flat, the dial’s little grey line follows the wind, and a guide with Papy’s tip opens before you start.
items.reachableStars: Some games’ three stars asked for an almost perfect game. Gustave’s mail, Yuzu’s washing up and kitchen, and Maître Kaito’s archery now ask a little less: still a challenge, but within your reach.
items.boosterLots: Got lots of boosters? In your bag, open 5 or 10 at once: a single cut, then all your cards at a glance, the best first.
items.clearShiftEnd: The skipping stones, archery and photos looked stuck once every pebble, arrow or shot was used. They now clearly say “Finished!”: press “See the score” for your result.
items.binderLastPage: On a computer, the binder’s right arrow no longer turns a page into nothing once you reach the end.
items.binderPageJump: In the binder, jump straight to the first or last page, or touch the page number to pick the one you want. On a keyboard, Home and End work too.
items.binderSwitch: The binder now shows its set’s logo. Touch it to switch straight to another of your binders without closing it.
items.summaryNewTag: Cards you didn’t own yet now get a big gold “NEW” tag, stamped on their corner, when revealed and in the summary, even when opening five or ten boosters at once.
items.passwordReset: Forgot your password? A link on the sign-in page now sends you an email to choose a new one.
items.paperMenus: The sign-in pages and the settings menu got a makeover, with soft paper sheets and chunkier buttons, and the kraft around the village now has the grain of real cardboard.
items.quickQuantity: Buying many boosters is quicker: pick ×5, ×10, ×20 or Max in one touch, type the number you want, or hold + or − to count fast.
items.enterToBuy: Buying at Mamie Noisette’s, or at the Card Den, is quicker with a keyboard: pick with the arrows, press Enter to buy, and go straight on to the next.
items.boosterControlsFix: Buying boosters is steady again: + and − count one per click and only race when held, and Enter on a booster goes to its quantity, where Enter buys.
items.holoFoil: Holo and reverse holo cards finally shine: a rainbow foil with glitter, on the illustration for holos and around it for reverses, that follows your mouse as you tilt the card.
items.packVolume: Booster packs look full now: their foil bulges with the cards inside, pinches at the seals and catches the light.
items.pullEffectsSetting: Opening effects give the cards away? Turn them off in the settings: your packs then open without the lights climbing up to their best card.
items.binderCardView: A card enlarged in the binder now has the screen to itself: the set’s logo and the button to close the binder no longer cover it.
items.version02: The game moves on to version 0.2! Thank you for playing and testing version 0.1. New things are on their way in this series.
items.avatarSpecies: A wardrobe has arrived in your bedroom! Open it to change animal: fox, turtle, dog, cat, rabbit, bear, wolf, gorilla, red panda or penguin, with your scarf and satchel.

lines.greeting: Welcome to Ramen Yuzu, {name}! Everything’s vegetarian and homemade. I’m always a pair of paws short: will you lend me a hand? I pay in coins.
lines.rewarded: What a shift! Here are {coins} coins, well earned. One more star, and I’ll pay you the difference.
lines.rewardedAll: Three stars, what a shift! Here are {coins} coins. You have earned every reward of this job for today.
lines.alreadyPaid: Thanks for the help! I already paid you for a score like that today: earn one more star to get more.
lines.allEarned: You have already earned every reward of this job today. Stay and help for the fun of it, or come back tomorrow!
lines.failed: Oops, that was a busy shift… No pay this time, but we can go again whenever you like!
lines.unavailable: Oh dear, the gas went out. Come back in a moment!

service.howTo: The village’s folk sit down and order. The bowl in hand goes to a table that ordered it: tap the table, or press its number. Serve quickly for a tip, and don’t leave anyone waiting too long!

yuzu.start: Here come the guests, over to you!

service.queue: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody at the door} one {# at the door:} other {# at the door:}}

dishes.howTo: Dirty bowls pile up in the tub. Scrub each bowl until its stains are gone (you can rub the bowl with your finger too), rinse it, then stack it. Bring your pile to Yuzu whenever you like: the taller it is, the bigger the bonus… but a pile too tall may topple! And if the tub overflows, bowls break.

yuzu.start: Here come the bowls, get scrubbing!
yuzu.tall: Your pile is swaying… bring it over?
yuzu.tubFull: The tub is about to overflow, quick!
yuzu.toppled: Oh no, all {count} bowls on the floor!

kitchen.howTo: The bowl rides along the belt: put the ticket’s ingredients in it, in any order, before it reaches the end. A bowl finished quickly earns a bonus. Mind your mistakes: one wrong ingredient spoils the bowl!

yuzu.start: The belt is rolling, over to you!

lines.greeting: Welcome to the dojo, {name}. Here we sharpen the hand and the mind. A slicing lesson, or an archery lesson? Every lesson well done earns a few coins.
lines.rewarded: Fine mastery. Here are {coins} coins: you earned them. One more star, and I’ll pay you the difference.
lines.rewardedAll: Three stars! Here are {coins} coins. You have earned every reward of this lesson for today.
lines.alreadyPaid: Good. I already paid you for a score like that today: earn one more star to get more.
lines.allEarned: You have already earned every reward of this lesson today. Train for the fun of it, or come back tomorrow!
lines.failed: Bamboo bends but does not break. No coins this time: try again whenever you like.
lines.unavailable: Hmm, the dojo is meditating. Come back in a moment.

slicing.howTo: Vegetables are thrown into the air. Slice them before they fall: sweep the blade through them with the mouse or a finger, or press 1 to 4 to slice a whole lane. At the top of their flight, the cut is clean. Several at once is a combo. But leave the clay pots alone!
slicing.board: Slicing area: sweep the blade through the vegetables

kaito.start: Breathe. The first vegetable is coming.
kaito.pot: Not the pot! It was my grandmother’s…
kaito.dropped: A vegetable on the floor… don’t let them slip by.

archery.howTo: In the dojo’s garden, ten arrows at the target. A line sweeps across the target from left to right: press Space, the button or touch the range to hold it. A second line then sweeps up and down: press again to hold it and shoot, where the two lines cross. The wind pushes the arrow sideways: hold the first line a little into the wind!

lines.rewarded: Thanks for the help! Here are {coins} coins. One more star, and I’ll pay you the difference.
lines.rewardedAll: Three stars, the park has never looked so good! Here are {coins} coins. You have earned every reward of this job for today.
lines.alreadyPaid: Thanks! I already paid you for a score like that today: earn one more star to get more.
lines.allEarned: You have already earned every reward of this job today. Stay and garden for the fun of it, or come back tomorrow!

cleanup.howTo: You stroll along the path pulling Pépin’s cart with its three bins. When a piece of litter comes within reach, in the circle in front of you, choose its bin: 1 Paper, 2 Packaging, 3 Glass, or click it. The wrong bin or a piece left behind is a mistake. Five good sorts in a row earn a bonus!

pepin.start: The wind is rising, keep your eyes open!

watering.title: Watering
watering.howTo: Pépin’s five flower beds are thirsty. Water each one three times, with a click or the keys 1 to 5, and watch them bloom. Once a day, {coins} coins.
watering.start: They’re thirsty, over to you. Take your time!
watering.going: That’s it, gently… they love it.
watering.thanks: Thank you, my flowers are delighted! Here are {coins} coins.
watering.notPaid: Thank you! I couldn’t count it, but my flowers are delighted.
watering.alreadyDone: My flowers have already had a drink today, {name}, thank you! No need to see to them, come back tomorrow.
watering.error: Oops, the fountain is off. Come back in a moment!

lines.greeting: Ah, {name}, did you know I was a stone-skipping champion? The secret is the angle and the strength. Show me what you can do: more skips, more coins!
lines.rewarded: Nice throw! Here are {coins} coins. One more star, and I’ll pay you the difference.
lines.rewardedAll: Three stars! Even I, at your age… Here are {coins} coins: you’ve earned everything for today.
lines.alreadyPaid: Well thrown! I already paid you for a score like that today: do better for one more star.
lines.allEarned: You have already earned every reward for skipping stones today. Throw for the fun of it, or come back tomorrow!
lines.failed: Splash! It happens to the best of us. Again?
lines.unavailable: Hmm, the lake is too choppy. Come back in a moment.

stones.howTo: Five pebbles to skip. A needle sweeps the angle: press Space, the button or touch the lake to hold it. A gauge then sweeps the strength: press again to throw. As on a real lake, throw low and flat, on the little grey line, which the wind moves, and the strength in the middle of the green band. Ten skips or more: a champion’s bonus!

stones.wind: Wind: {strength, select, calm {calm} light {light} other {strong}}{direction, select, left {, to the left} right {, to the right} other {}}

papy.start: Watch the reeds: they tell you where the wind comes from.
papy.wind: The wind is strong: shift your angle.

flat.title: Low and flat
flat.text: A needle sweeps the angle. Stop it low, on the little grey line: as on a real lake, a pebble thrown too high sinks.

wind.title: The wind
wind.text: The wind moves the grey line a little, and the reeds lean with it. Wind to the right: a little higher. Wind to the left: even lower.

strength.title: The strength
strength.text: Once the angle is held, a gauge rises and falls. Throw when it is in the middle of the green band: not too hard, not too soft.

secret.title: Papy’s tip
secret.text: The needle on the grey line, the gauge in the middle of the green: twelve skips. From ten, a champion’s bonus. The first pebble has hardly any wind: make it count!

lines.rewarded: Well done! Here are {coins} coins. One more star, and I’ll pay you the difference.
lines.rewardedAll: Three stars, Pop’Balloons champion! Here are {coins} coins: you’ve earned everything for today.
lines.alreadyPaid: Nice! I already paid you for a score like that today: earn one more star to get more.
lines.allEarned: You have already earned every Pop’Balloons reward today. Play for fun, or come back tomorrow!
lines.failed: Oops, too many wrong balloons! Again?
lines.unavailable: Bother, my balloon pump is playing up. Come back in a moment!

balloons.howTo: Balloons of four colours rise in four lanes, and I call a colour, which often changes. Click or tap a balloon to pop it, or press 1 to 4 to pop the highest of a lane before it floats away. The called colour scores a point, any other is a mistake. Five good ones in a row earn a bonus!

lines.greeting: Hello, {name}! The mail is piling up, will you help me sort it? I pay in coins, and the more stars you earn, the more I pay.
lines.rewarded: Thank you! Here are {coins} coins. One more star, and I’ll pay you the difference.
lines.rewardedAll: Three stars, a real sorting pro! Here are {coins} coins: you’ve earned everything for today.
lines.alreadyPaid: Thank you! I already paid you for a score like that today: earn one more star to get more.
lines.allEarned: You have already earned every sorting reward today. Sort for fun, or come back tomorrow!
lines.failed: Ouch, a few letters went astray… Again?
lines.unavailable: Hmm, my mailbag is stuck. Come back in a moment!

mail.howTo: Letters reach the counter one at a time. File each in the pigeonhole of its stamp, with the keys 1 to 4 or a click. Express letters, edged in red, count double if you’re quick. A parcel takes two presses. The wrong pigeonhole, or a letter that slips off the counter, is a mistake.

Quiz.title: Mamie Noisette’s quiz
Quiz.howTo: Five questions about the village and its folk, three answers each. Take your time! Each right answer pays {coins} coins, once a day.
Quiz.question: Question {number} of {total}
Quiz.result: {right, plural, =0 {No right answers} one {# right answer} other {# right answers}} out of {total}
Quiz.thanks: Well done, {name}! Here are {coins} coins for knowing the village so well.
Quiz.noCoins: Hee hee, not easy! Come back tomorrow for other questions.
Quiz.alreadyDone: You have already done the quiz today, {name}. Come back tomorrow for new questions!
Quiz.error: Oh, I’ve lost my cards… Come back in a moment.

lines.greeting: Hi, {name}! Hot-air balloons and kites are drifting over the towers. Will you take a few photos for me? I pay in coins, and the sharper they are, the more I pay.
lines.rewarded: Great shots! Here are {coins} coins. One more star, and I’ll pay you the difference.
lines.rewardedAll: Three stars, these are going in my gallery! Here are {coins} coins: you’ve earned everything for today.
lines.alreadyPaid: Lovely photos! I already paid you for a score like that today: earn one more star to get more.
lines.allEarned: You have already earned every photo reward today. Shoot for fun, or come back tomorrow!
lines.unavailable: Oops, my film is stuck. Come back in a moment!

photos.howTo: Hot-air balloons and kites cross the viewfinder. Press Space, Enter, the button or click the viewfinder when one passes through the centre, in the golden ring. The more centred it is, the sharper the photo, and a kite is worth more. You have 8 photos, the flash recharges between shots, and a photo of an empty sky is a mistake.

Puzzle.title: Pinceau’s puzzle
Puzzle.howTo: Slide the pieces into the empty square to put the painting back together: click a piece next to it, or use the arrow keys. No clock! The painting pays {coins} coins, and {quickCoins} in {moves} moves or fewer, once a day.
